name: chocolate-notebook
description: Compare bars, blends and declared labels.

interface.longDescription: Compare bars, blends and declared labels. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Compare chocolate price by weight; Calculate a weighted cacao blend; Compare declared allergens and tasting notes. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me compare chocolate price by weight.
Help me calculate a weighted cacao blend.

prompts: Help me compare chocolate price by weight.
Help me calculate a weighted cacao blend.
Help me compare declared allergens and tasting notes.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Cacao Pages: Tasting Notes workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Compare chocolate price by weight. Reproducible inputs: {"bars":[{"name":"Origin A","price":5,"weight_g":80,"cacao_pct":70},{"name":"Origin B","price":6,"weight_g":100,"cacao_pct":75}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare chocolate price by weight with these supplied values: {"bars":[{"name":"Origin A","price":5,"weight_g":80,"cacao_pct":70},{"name":"Origin B","price":6,"weight_g":100,"cacao_pct":75}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses chocolate_notebook_bar_unit_price with the supplied inputs. Returns {"bars":[{"name":"Origin B","price":6,"weight_g":100,"cacao_pct":75,"price_per_100g":6},{"name":"Origin A","price":5,"weight_g":80,"cacao_pct":70,"price_per_100g":6.25}],"note":"Cacao percentage alone is not a quality, sweetness or safety score."}. Shows the actual bars result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Calculate a weighted cacao blend. Reproducible inputs: {"portions":[{"name":"Dark","grams":100,"cacao_pct":80},{"name":"Milk","grams":100,"cacao_pct":40}]}
positive.prompt: Help me calculate a weighted cacao blend with these supplied values: {"portions":[{"name":"Dark","grams":100,"cacao_pct":80},{"name":"Milk","grams":100,"cacao_pct":40}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses chocolate_notebook_blend_cacao with the supplied inputs. Returns {"total_grams":200,"weighted_cacao_pct":60,"portions":[{"name":"Dark","grams":100,"cacao_pct":80},{"name":"Milk","grams":100,"cacao_pct":40}]}. Shows the actual recipe result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Compare declared allergens and tasting notes. Reproducible inputs: {"avoid":["milk","nuts"],"bars":[{"name":"Bar A","declared":["milk"],"texture":"Creamy","origin":"As labeled"},{"name":"Bar B","declared":[],"texture":"Firm snap","origin":"As labeled"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare declared allergens and tasting notes with these supplied values: {"avoid":["milk","nuts"],"bars":[{"name":"Bar A","declared":["milk"],"texture":"Creamy","origin":"As labeled"},{"name":"Bar B","declared":[],"texture":"Firm snap","origin":"As labeled"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses chocolate_notebook_chocolate_label_notes with the supplied inputs. Returns {"bars":[{"name":"Bar A","declared":["milk"],"texture":"Creamy","origin":"As labeled","declared_matches":["milk"],"safety_status":"Not verified"},{"name":"Bar B","declared":[],"texture":"Firm snap","origin":"As labeled","declared_matches":[],"safety_status":"Not verified"}],"note":"Exact supplied declarations only; verify aliases, complete labels and cross-contact information."}. Shows the actual labels result. Does not fabricate external data.
